notes: Corrected one head. s026 ὁ → the ... man now heads on man (t032) rather than the (t030). The edges were right — rule 49 gives the supplied generic noun to the article where its complement is an adjective — but rule 22 fixes the head inside such a unit on the nominal word and never on the determiner, naming τὸ → the part in terms, and rule 60 confirms it for τῆς μελλούσης → that hour which. Rule 17's on the → the applies only where a case preposition realizes the article's case, which is not this construction.
Everything else is unchanged. Every s001–s032 and t001–t037 id is used exactly once; each single-token unit takes its own source head.

Two contested heads are noted in place: καύσωνι → scorching wind (rule 66/91 head on scorching, against a head on wind), and ὁ πλούσιος → the rich man, where rule 49 puts the supplied generic noun on the article against the competing reading that gives man to πλούσιος on rule 66's anarthrous covetous man.

The three αὐτοῦ tokens are handled by rule 20's availability test: thereof (s015) and of it (s022) are the pronoun's own English and leave their articles the ordinary the, while the possessive his (s031) empties s029.
